text_block_list.text:
While eating in the cafeteria, I hear a

conversation between three students
conducting
what appears to be a study
session.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Let us begin. I don't mean to boast,
but when it
comes to classical literature,
I am confident in my
teaching abilities.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
My deepest thanks! The president of the

disciplinary committee can't be failing
her tests!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the help too. I'm not great
at essay
questions... They take me ages.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Very well. Let us begin by reading the
original
text. I shall ask questions based
on the text
afterward. Are we all ready?
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Ready when you are! I'll nail any
question you
throw at me!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: Mmhm. I hope I get a good grade.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: ...Ahem. I shall now start reading the passage aloud. "The Hunting of the Nue" by Minamoto no Yorimasa, from The Tale of the Heike...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
"Now, Minamoto no Yorimasa
descended in the
fifth generation from
Yorimitsu, the governor of
Settsu. His
grandfather was Yoritsuna, governor
of
Mikawa..."
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
"The greatest of all his exploits... to have
a mount
warrior guard, and among those
of the Genji and
Heike, the choice, so
the story goes..."
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
...My apologies. We should start on a
simpler
level, with the modern
translation.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
"Many a year ago, a yokai known as a
nue would
wreak havoc on all, night
after night."
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
"The reigning emperor ordered a warrior
named
Yorimasa to slay it. And the
secret strategy
Yorimasa devised to slay
it was—"
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
...I know! I bet he lured it with food and
then
killed it.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text: ...Wrong.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Really? Huh.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I must make it clear that this is not a
game in
which you guess what happens
next. In fact, I
haven't even asked any
questions ye—
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Oh, oh! I know! Pick me, pick me!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: Go ahead. What is it that you "know"?
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: I'll bet... he never even slayed it at all!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Yorimasa and the nue clash,
head-to-head! They
fight
fair-and-square, throwing themselves
into it!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
They continue to fight, day and night,
until
something blossoms between
them... A peculiar
kinship!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
So they promise to train real hard and
then fight
again someday... before
parting ways!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
And then Yorimasa spends his days
fighting yokai
until... One day! He's
surrounded by the Four
Yokai Kings! It's
a life-or-death situation!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
But then! A single shadow slices through
the dark
clouds! Who could it be?!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
"I believe I said... I would be the one to
defeat
you!" That's right! It's the nue!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
Hooo, talk about intense! Yesterday's
enemy
ends up today's friend! A
friendship that blossoms
through battle!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: The Tale of the Heike is all about battles with lotsa warriors, right?! I'll bet that's what happens!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
...What a touching story. That's amazing,

Bamboo. You've got the story all figured
out.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! I'm gaining some real
confidence in
this subject! I might even
aim for a perfect score
on the next test!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
Bamboo... While I must admit that I hold
your
storytelling abilities in high
regard...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, The Tale of the Heike is not that kind of story.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
It looks like many obstacles are going to
hinder
the progress of their test
studies...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
